name: generate_video_project
description: Default fixed background workflow for every new chat video, including a single short clip and a finished video longer than one model clip. For a simple single-clip brief without an explicit duration, call this tool directly with prompt and any requested model or references; omit total_duration_seconds so the Host resolves actual defaults in one call. Do not load directing skills, write a long storyboard or call list_video_models first for that simple case. For explicit timing or complex plans, read list_video_models for actual controls; never discover support by paid retries or silently replace an explicitly named model. Use the yunshu-video-director skill for story, character/reference continuity, dialogue and subtitles, then call this native workflow; do not write polling, download or assembly scripts or manually repeat generate_video for each visual cut. One paid clip can contain several camera beats. For requests such as a 40-second video, plan the fewest supported clips (for a 15-second limit: 15+15+10, or three 15-second clips trimmed to 40), generate independent clips with gateway-approved bounded parallelism using the signed-in account, then normalize, trim, and join them in timeline order. Older gateways remain serial; the API owns shared account capacity. Do not launch a separate agent or generation-tool call for every clip. For a catalog with H3 single clips limited to 4–15 seconds, 60 seconds means four 15-second clips, never one 30-second clip. All local tools and every request are checked before billing. Returns a background job_id and durable project_id; read job_output at measured intervals for queued/generating progress and call present on the completed final_path. A busy response without an accepted task id is unknown, not confirmed queue admission. Use job_kill when the user stops; accepted provider tasks may continue billing. A query deadline retains task ids for explicit resume, never a fresh submission. Never claim completion before the job reports a saved final_path. If a current user-supplied chat attachment is outside the workspace, first copy that read-authorized attachment into this workspace with the existing file tools, then pass the copied path; do not copy unrelated files.

plan_id.description: Explicit update_creation_plan id. Also supply shot_ids in generation order.

shot_ids.description: Exact shot ids belonging to plan_id, one per actual supported model clip and in the saved timeline order. Multiple visual cuts may share one paid clip; do not create an unsupported paid clip for each camera beat.

prompt.description: The complete video brief, visual continuity, story, and desired editing. Before calling, script user-delegated narrative or dialogue scenes with stable character ids, language and brief exact lines, identifying on-screen speakers versus narration; preserve user-supplied wording. Assign each line and its timing to a shot in shot_prompts. Do not reduce a story requiring voices to a music montage. Respect silent/no-dialogue requests and do not add dialogue or subtitles to unrelated nonverbal videos. Include requested lip-sync and subtitle requirements. These request native model generation, not separate speech, lip-sync or subtitle processing; verify the rendered result before claiming they are met.

total_duration_seconds.description: Desired final length in whole seconds; this may exceed the model single-clip limit. For a simple single clip with no plan or explicit shot arrays, omit to use the selected model’s actual default duration. The Host reads the real catalog itself; no separate list_video_models call is needed. Required for explicit plans and shot arrays; never omit a user-specified duration.

shot_prompts.description: Exact shot briefs, one per planned clip. With plan_id and shot_ids, omit to use each saved shot’s scene, camera, action, prompt, exact dialogue/subtitles and associated character definitions without another model call. Explicit values remain verbatim. Otherwise allocate delegated narrative lines and timing to stable speakers, distinguishing on-screen speech from narration. Respect silent/no-dialogue requests.

shot_durations_seconds.description: Exact model-supported whole seconds per clip, in shot_ids or shot_prompts order. Their sum must equal total_duration_seconds. When omitted for an explicit creation plan, use its saved shot durations; do not silently change timeline timing.

model.description: Exact id from list_video_models. Preserve an explicitly requested model; never silently switch it. Otherwise choose an available account model using its returned duration, dimension and audio declarations.

audio.description: Optional requested audio state from list_video_models, not a capability probe. Sent as a switch only when the chosen model declares one; fixed native audio accepts only its declared state. No switch does not mean silent output; an undeclared audio state remains unknown. Do not blindly send true, and do not promise speech, lip-sync, subtitles or silence without checking the media.

frame_images.description: Existing uploaded ma_ first/last frame ids or workspace image paths. For a user-supplied chat attachment outside the workspace, first copy the read-authorized attachment into the workspace with existing file tools and pass its copied path.

reference_images.description: Shared uploaded ma_ subject/style image ids or workspace image paths used by every shot. With plan_id, each shot’s saved image materials and character references are added only to that shot; do not duplicate unrelated character references here. For a user-supplied chat attachment outside the workspace, first copy the read-authorized attachment into the workspace with existing file tools and pass its copied path.

reference_videos.description: Existing uploaded ma_ video reference ids or workspace video paths. For a user-supplied chat attachment outside the workspace, first copy the read-authorized attachment into the workspace with existing file tools and pass its copied path.

reference_audios.description: Existing uploaded ma_ audio reference ids or workspace WAV/MP3 paths, only when the chosen model supports audio references. For a user-supplied chat attachment outside the workspace, first copy the read-authorized attachment into the workspace with existing file tools and pass its copied path. A reference does not guarantee copied speech, matching mouth movements or subtitles.

name: edit_video
description: Edit existing local videos without generating new media or spending model credits. Order clips as supplied, optionally trim each start/end in seconds, normalize and concatenate them, and optionally trim the final length. Input files must be readable inside this workspace or an owned generated-video project. Returns a background job_id; wait for the real final_path, then call present and include the artifact link. This performs ordered cuts and joins; it does not synthesize unseen footage, music, subtitles, or effects. If current user-supplied chat attachments are outside the workspace, first copy only those read-authorized attachments into this workspace with existing file tools, then edit the copied paths.

clips.description: Local clip paths in final playback order, with optional per-clip trim positions. Copy current user-supplied, read-authorized chat attachments from outside the workspace into the workspace with existing file tools before passing their copied paths.

total_duration_seconds.description: Optional final duration after assembling clips; cannot exceed the available trimmed footage.

name: generate_image
description: Generate images or edit reference images through the signed-in account relay, save every result into the artifacts directory, and return the paths. For pending or unknown results, never resubmit this tool: use query_image_task with the original plan_id and operation_id when a task_id was received. Without a task_id, retain the unknown outcome and reconcile the original request before any paid retry. For image-to-image requests, pass the current-chat user attachment or an authorized workspace image in reference_images. Which image models exist, and what each one accepts, is the deployment’s own answer: ask for a model only when the user names one. For Yunshu platform, relay or upstream failures, give users only a safe Simplified Chinese summary such as “服务器繁忙，请稍后重试”; never repeat raw HTTP responses, diagnostic JSON, error codes, stacks, internal paths or credentials. Keep actionable guidance for confirmed sign-in, product-credit, file-validation and cancellation failures. When submission or billing outcome is unknown, check existing tasks and artifacts first; do not immediately retry or automatically resubmit. Preserve real tool results. This restriction does not prevent software or code diagnostics explicitly requested by the user.

plan_id.description: Explicit update_creation_plan id for this generation. Also provide exactly one of shot_id or asset_id.

shot_id.description: Exact shot id in the explicit plan; never guess a latest project.

asset_id.description: Exact image asset id in plan_id, including a video plan. Mutually exclusive with shot_id. Creates or reconstructs this source asset, not a finished shot.

model.description: Optional image model id such as gpt-image-2. Defaults to the first image model the deployment serves for this account.

size.description: Optional output size such as 1024x1024 or auto. A value the chosen model does not support is refused with that model’s own menu. For yunshu-internal-gpt-image-2, omit pixel size; the server controls output settings.

resolution.description: Optional named output tier, only when declared by the chosen model. yunshu-internal-gpt-image-2 accepts 1k, 2k or 4k and defaults to 1k; this is independent from pixel size.

count.description: How many images to render, within the model’s limit (usually 1–4).

reference_images.description: Reference images for editing: current-chat user image attachment ids or their exact read-only paths, readable PNG/JPEG/WebP files inside the current workspace, uploaded ma_ ids, or real generated image output ids/paths owned by the same explicit plan_id. Other-chat attachments, unrelated local paths and URLs are refused.

name: generate_video
description: Compatibility single-clip generation through the account relay. Read list_video_models first. Prefer generate_video_project for new video requests, including a single clip: its background job exposes queue and generation progress without holding chat open. Do not write submission, polling or download scripts or probe invalid paid durations. For story direction, character/reference continuity, dialogue or subtitles, use the yunshu-video-director skill. For a complete video such as 40 seconds or automatic assembly, always use generate_video_project; several camera beats may fit one clip. Accepted work that outlasts this foreground wait returns pending: query_video_task reads its original receipt, never generate again. Edit existing clips with edit_video. Only declared duration, resolution, ratio, frames and references are accepted. For Yunshu platform, relay or upstream failures, give users only a safe Simplified Chinese summary such as “服务器繁忙，请稍后重试”; never repeat raw HTTP responses, diagnostic JSON, error codes, stacks, internal paths or credentials. Keep actionable guidance for confirmed sign-in, product-credit, file-validation and cancellation failures. When submission or billing outcome is unknown, check existing tasks and artifacts first; do not immediately retry or automatically resubmit. Preserve real tool results. This restriction does not prevent software or code diagnostics explicitly requested by the user.

plan_id.description: Explicit update_creation_plan id for this generation. Also provide shot_id.

shot_id.description: Exact shot id in the explicit plan; never guess a latest project.

prompt.description: What the video should show. Before calling, script user-delegated narrative or dialogue scenes with stable character ids, language, brief exact lines and their timing, identifying on-screen speakers versus narration; preserve user-supplied wording. Do not reduce a story requiring voices to a music montage. Respect silent/no-dialogue requests and do not add dialogue or subtitles to unrelated nonverbal videos. Include requested lip-sync and subtitle requirements. These request native model generation, not separate speech, lip-sync or subtitle processing; verify the rendered result before claiming they are met.

model.description: Optional video model id such as MiniMax-H3. Defaults to the first video model the deployment serves for this account.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length in seconds; only values the chosen model declares are accepted.

resolution.description: Output resolution such as 768P or 2K, when the model offers choices.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 9:16; adaptive inherits it from the reference media.

audio.description: Optional requested audio state. Sent as a switch only when the chosen model declares one; fixed native audio accepts only its declared state. An audio stream does not verify dialogue, lip-sync or subtitles.

frame_images.description: Optional stored ids (ma_…) used as first/last frame.

reference_images.description: Optional stored ids (ma_…) used as multimodal subject/style references, when the model supports them.

reference_videos.description: Optional stored ids (ma_…) used as a reference video, when the model supports video-to-video.

reference_audios.description: Optional uploaded ma_ audio ids or workspace WAV/MP3 paths, when the model supports audio references. First copy a user-supplied, read-authorized chat attachment outside the workspace into the workspace using existing file tools; do not copy unrelated files. References do not guarantee copied speech, matching mouth movements or subtitles.
